nodes.title: LOCKED MITCH GROUP-SCENE RECIPE
widgets_values:
# FLUX.2 Klein 9B Mitch Group Scene Studio v1

This is the reusable version of the group result Mitch approved on 2026-08-31.

1. Load a genuine source group photograph.
2. Set `target_x` and `target_y` near the person who should become Mitch (`0` is left/top; `1` is right/bottom). The default `0.50, 0.44` selects the central lounge person.
3. Describe the entire desired group photo. State where Mitch is, his clothing, and any scene-specific details.
4. Keep `head_scale 0.92` unless a new source needs a measured adjustment.

The node automatically detects the target face, builds a Canny layout, removes the source person's internal eye/nose/mouth edges, scales only the outer target-head contour, and then supplies the locked genuine Mitch reference separately.

Locked generation settings:
- FLUX.2 Klein Base 9B
- V3 step-1600 Mitch LoRA at `0.90`
- Genuine native front-neutral reference at `1.00 MP`
- Face-free scene layout at `0.25 MP`
- `832 × 1216`, 50 Euler steps, CFG `4.0`
- RTX 3090 only

This is whole-frame native generation. It does not use face swap, restoration, sharpening, or a post-generation identity pass. Review every result for exactly one Mitch, correct target selection, anatomy, hands, and full-frame integration.

nodes.title: APPROVED KLEIN 9B GROUP SCENE STUDIO
widgets_values: A photorealistic vertical phone-flash group photograph matching the source. Four adults sit closely on the rust-orange booth, with a partial fifth person at the extreme image-right edge. Mitch is the selected central seated man, wearing a fitted dark navy suit and crisp white open-collar shirt. Both complete forearms extend down and his separate hands rest on his thighs. Keep every surrounding person distinct and unrelated. Preserve the source camera framing, people count, seated body poses, copper wall, amber perimeter light, booth, low table, objects, ordinary smartphone perspective, direct flash, and seamless natural detail.
